headline: Halloween Time Hits the Home Stretch
tagline: Four weeks left of ghoulish fun — and the holidays are only six weeks away.

lead.title: Oogie Boogie Bash: Last Chance to Crash the Party
lead.body: The after-hours Halloween party at Disney California Adventure is in its final weeks, with a record 33 dates this year. The big debut is "Madame Leota's Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party," plus new villain appearances including Yzma. Expect treat trails, character meet-ups and shorter attraction waits. Check the official calendar for remaining dates before you go.

events.title: Halloween Time at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: Both parks are decked out, with the "Mickey's Trick and Treat" daytime show and the "Halloween Screams" nighttime spectacle on select evenings.

events.title: Haunted Mansion Holiday
events.body: Jack Skellington's Nightmare Before Christmas takeover of the Haunted Mansion runs all the way into the new year.

events.title: Plaza de la Familia
events.body: A Día de los Muertos celebration with the street show "The Storytellers of the Plaza de la Familia Celebrate the Musical World of Coco!", live mariachi and a memory wall.

events.title: Cars Land Overlays
events.body: Luigi's Honkin' Haul-O-Ween and Mater's Graveyard JamBOOree, plus Guardians of the Galaxy – Monsters After Dark at Avengers Campus.

events.title: World of Color – One
events.body: The fan-favorite World of Color show is back for a limited run before the holiday show takes over.

events.title: Bluey's Best Day Ever!
events.body: A live stage show starring Bluey and Bingo, debuted in March. Showtimes vary, so check the Disneyland app.

events.title: Holidays at the Disneyland Resort
events.body: "Believe … in Holiday Magic" fireworks, "A Christmas Fantasy Parade," it's a small world Holiday, Wintertime Enchantment at the Castle and Festival of Holidays marketplaces at DCA.

events.title: World of Color – Season of Light
events.body: The holiday edition of World of Color returns; performance schedule had not been announced as of this issue.

events.title: Chip and Dale's Ornament Trail
events.body: The collectible ornament hunt returns to Downtown Disney District for the holidays.

tip: Most Halloween and holiday entertainment is included with park admission. Oogie Boogie Bash needs its own ticket.
caveats: Dates come from Disney press releases and fan sites as of Oct 2, 2026. Always confirm in the Disneyland app.
